messages:
Lucas: Rolled q9a-int4 to canary. Perf +20% but seeing a consistent drop on our multiturn procedural prompts (promptset: howto_long). Might be kv-cache edge-case or fused-softmax numeric drift.
Mina: Can you paste a short failing example and the metric delta?
Lucas: Short example: user asks multi-step restore; q9a adds a bogus flag and omits a step. Diffs vs q8a-int8: ROUGE-L -2.0, ExactMatch -2.8, hallucination +0.10.
Jorge: We recently reindexed anchorbank which may have shifted microgolden alignment. Recommend two parallel actions: 1) fuzzy dedupe sweep of howto_long (threshold 0.8) + export sample ids; 2) 120-sample microgolden relabel focused on long multi-turns.
Priya: I'll prioritize relabel if you post the ids. Set QA pass 94% and add tag "invented-entity".
label-bot: Created LR-8123 "q9a-int4 howto_long microgolden" with 120 items, priority: high.
Mina: Also run quick ablation: q9a-int4 (current), q9a-int4 --legacy-softmax, q9a-int8 baseline. If legacy-softmax matches int8, we isolate to fused-softmax.
Lucas: Repro command: `./eval.sh --model q9a-int4 --prompts howto_long.json --out /tmp/q9a_diff.json`
ops-bot: Canary fallback created: tokens>500 & turns>3 -> q8a-int8-canary at 2876543305.
Jorge: Good. After relabel and ablation, if labels confirm hallucination increase tied to int4 kernel, open runtime rollback for the fused-softmax change.
Lucas: Will post relabel summary and ablation table here. ETA ~24h.
Priya: Thanks 44d will monitor LR task and QA results.
Mina: If relabel clears, we probably need a small golden refresh and update provenance. If not, rollback to legacy-softmax on canary then reassess.
Lucas: Agreed, keeping scope narrow to reduce label churn.
